title: Using services
summary: Inflect the lemma in brackets. The case is fixed by the surrounding words.

post-loc.sentenceGloss: Envelopes are sold at the post office.
post-loc.note: Locative singular: пошта in the second case singular.

bank-loc.sentenceGloss: My sister opened an account at a bank.
bank-loc.note: Locative singular: банк in the second case singular.

library-loc.sentenceGloss: There is a reading room in the library.
library-loc.note: Locative singular: бібліотека in the second case singular.

stamp-acc.sentenceGloss: Oleh stuck a stamp on the envelope.
stamp-acc.note: Accusative: what is stuck on takes the accusative.

card-acc.sentenceGloss: Iryna ordered a card at the bank.
card-acc.note: Accusative: what is ordered takes the accusative.

address-acc.note: Accusative: the address that is written takes the accusative.

bookshop-loc.sentenceGloss: This textbook is sold at the bookshop.
bookshop-loc.note: Locative singular: книгарня in the second case singular.

sender-gen.sentenceGloss: The sender's name is missing from the envelope.
sender-gen.note: Genitive: імені відправника — the sender's name.

recipient-dat.sentenceGloss: The money was handed to the recipient.
recipient-dat.note: Dative: the money was handed to the recipient.

transfer-gen.sentenceGloss: A document is needed to receive the transfer.
transfer-gen.note: Genitive: отримання переказу — of the transfer.

form-gen.sentenceGloss: The number of the reader’s registration form has changed.
form-gen.note: Genitive: читацького формуляра — of the reader's form.
